name: Hugo
description_en:
Hugo was a meeting-notes product. An official Fellow transition article announced a November 2022 shutdown and described historical migration steps. The recorded homepage now redirects to MeetingNotes, a content site.

Do not treat the inherited directory features or price snapshot as a currently available Hugo subscription. Current account access, export availability and migration-tool operation need community or operator confirmation.
description_zh:
Hugo 曾是会议笔记产品。Fellow 官方交接文章宣布将于 2022 年 11 月关闭，并说明历史迁移步骤。记录中的首页当前跳转至 MeetingNotes 内容站。

不能把继承的目录功能或价格快照当作当前可购买的 Hugo 订阅。现有账户访问、导出可用性及迁移工具运行情况需要社区或运营方补充确认。
